why_a_separate_schema: Task A (16 expense categories) answers 'what was the money spent on'. Rent receipts, school-fee receipts, insurance premium receipts, loan certificates, Form 16 and salary slips are not expense categories: a school-fee receipt is expense_category 'miscellaneous', an insurance premium receipt may be 'medical' or 'miscellaneous'. Forcing them into Task A would conflate 'what it is' with 'what it was spent on'.

config/taxonomy.json (document profile) holds rule evidence for employee-benefit documents and is NOT a trained model. This schema is the label space for a future TRAINED document-type classifier and for the evaluation manifest; it does not replace Task A and does not replace the profile rules, it complements them.
Tax evidence (axis C) is derived from document_type + rule evidence + employee data. It is never predicted as an eligibility decision.

C_tax_evidence.cardinality: multi-label, DERIVED (not an independently trained classifier)
C_tax_evidence.eligibility_status: always 'pending_verification'; tax eligibility is decided by app/tax/engine.py from employee data and verified by HR - never by classification
C_tax_evidence.note: insurance premium receipts can be life (80C) or health (80D) - the document type alone cannot tell; both candidates are listed and the rule layer / human decides

multi_label_policy: document_type is single-label with a 'needs_review' outcome; a document that fits two types (e.g. combined home-loan interest + principal certificate) keeps ONE primary document_type plus secondary_types[]; tax evidence is multi-label by construction.

document_type_definitions.invoice: business-to-business or GST tax invoice with line items and tax breakup
document_type_definitions.fuel_receipt: petrol/diesel/EV-charging receipt from a fuel or charging station
document_type_definitions.rent_receipt: receipt from a landlord for rent paid for a period (HRA supporting document)
document_type_definitions.insurance_premium_receipt: insurer's premium receipt or premium certificate (life or health)
document_type_definitions.school_fee_receipt: school / college fee receipt, ideally with a fee breakup
document_type_definitions.loan_interest_certificate: lender's certificate or statement of interest and/or principal repaid (housing, education, vehicle)
document_type_definitions.investment_certificate: statement/receipt for PPF, ELSS, NSC, SSY, tax-saver FD, LIC premium etc.
document_type_definitions.meal_voucher_statement: Sodexo / Pluxee / equivalent meal-card or coupon statement or invoice
document_type_definitions.ev_document: EV purchase/lease invoice, charging invoice, EV loan or employer EV policy letter
document_type_definitions.form_16: TDS certificate issued by an employer (Part A/B)
document_type_definitions.other: anything else / not a financial document

source_label_map._comment: mapping of SOURCE labels already present in datasets/metadata/manifest.jsonl to document_type; the original label is always kept next to the mapped one. Rules are by source label only - no visual re-labelling.

coverage_requirements.note: thresholds are a project policy for 'meaningful evaluation', not a statistical guarantee
